title: First Light
location: Surface Emergence — the lab-exit tunnel and the Emergence Point
summary: Fight clear of the collapsing facility and stand, for the first time in six months, under an open sky that isn't Earth's.

objectives.text: Push through the service tunnel to the surface. Don't stop moving.
Take stock. Whoever made it out is standing with you now.
Everyone you reached is here. Mark the route into the crystal desert.
Someone isn't here. The desert won't wait for the count.
Mark the route into the crystal desert.
Cross the Emergence Point's edge into the Crystalline Desert.

_hooks: Opens Act 2 directly off act2_world's L8 (the lab-exit gauntlet + the Emergence-Point awe beat + the allied companion markers Sarah/Aria/Keisha/Emily). The two-suns reveal sets cradle.core_seen (Biomesh/Cradle thread (b)+(e): the player is now ON the seeded world, the recontextualization can begin). Branches read the F2 triage outcome (girl_saved/girl_lost) so a clean Alpha/Omega run gets the warm gather and a Beta run gets the grief beat — neither blocks the spine. Chains into act2_mourners_debt (L10).
_voice: Awe, not exposition. The reveal does the talking; the objective text stays terse and physical ("Don't stop moving.").
